description: This file defines repository classes for handling database operations related to Users and Tasks in a task management system, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM. It provides encapsulated CRUD methods, error handling, and external references to models and security functions.

classes.name: RepositoryError
classes.description: Base custom exception class for repository-related errors.

classes.name: DuplicateEmailError
classes.description: Exception raised when attempting to create a user with an email that already exists.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository class encapsulating database operations for user entities, including creation, retrieval, and authentication.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing CRUD operations for tasks, including creation, listing, retrieval, update, and deletion.

methods.name: User create_user(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Creates a new user with a hashed password, handling duplicate email errors.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_by_email(self, db: Session, *, email: str)
methods.description: Fetches a user record based on email address.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate(self, db: Session, *, email: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns the user if successful.

methods.name: Task create_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, title: str, description: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Creates a new task associated with a user.

methods.name: Sequence[Task] list_tasks(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks for a specified user.

methods.name: Optional[Task] get_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific task by ID, ensuring it belongs to the specified user.

methods.name: Optional[Task] update_task( self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, is_completed: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Updates task details with validations, restricted to the owning user.

methods.name: bool delete_task(self, db: Session, *, user_id: int, task_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a specified task if it belongs to the user.
